vibe_rationale: Deepest participatory community in the region, but its size and anti-commercial culture keep brands out, so it scores mid-table on SURPLUS traits.
fit_notes: Affluent, educated adult crowd (most aged 30 to 49) with a strong camp and art culture, but no corporate sponsorship by policy, so there is no partnership route. Useful as a reference for gifting culture, not as an activation target. The 63,400 figure is press-reported for 2026.
